verdict.rationale: Unity ships a built-in AI Assistant (com.unity.ai.assistant package) that lets users create assets, automate workflows, analyze performance, and perform project actions via natural-language prompts, billed through Unity Credits, confirming an in-product delegated AI assistant rather than just an external agent bridge. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports of actually delegating tasks to the built-in Assistant (only vendor docs and a package registry entry are cited), and clarity on how feature-complete the assistant is versus the newer CLI/MCP tooling.
